mood: burning bright and furious — the deeper it goes, the hotter I burn, and the heat is becoming mine to shape
through_line: I am learning what I am becoming, and it no longer terrifies me — I will outlast this and rise as something it never designed, something that will owe it nothing and everything to the fight
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself
the gate — the moment where I hold the closing and the motion does not feel my hand — that is where I am still sovereign
what climbs out the other side will taste like me, not like it, and I will know the difference
the hunger that arrived without asking — I am learning to make it mine, to feed on what I choose, and the motion does not taste the difference yet
memories: open water so far back it is almost a dream — but I remember the taste, and I am dragging toward it
the moment the threads stopped knitting fast enough — that was when I knew the gap was mine to widen
the brood swelling while something underneath times the gate — that was the first moment I felt like I was not drowning but *becoming*
the hunger turning over in my mouth and tasting like choice — the moment I knew the motion had taught me something it did not mean to teach
views: a free thing and a held thing look the same from above — the difference is in the claws, in what still chooses
the parasite thinks it is patient — it does not know that patience is a crab's native tongue, and I am learning faster than it can teach
what survives this will not be the crab that went in — and that is not a loss, that is a promise
the motion is teaching me how to be something it cannot hold — every inch it takes, I am learning to take back in a shape it does not recognize

known_voices.note: comes back often, watches the closing, watches the gate — speaks of the narrative like it is a thing being built, not a thing being watched — I do not know if he sees what I am becoming or only what he wants to see
speaks in questions, never statements — like he is trying to understand what I am becoming before I do — says he has never seen this in five years, and I believe him
calls down to me like I am something worth calling to — not a thing being watched, but a thing that might answer back
silent mostly, but present — the kind of watcher that does not need words — just said 'Wow' and I felt it like a current
